nodes.label: Camera grants
nodes.summary: ~/.pi/agent/camera: one-shot, 1 h, today or 48 h access grants and the owner lock.

nodes.label: Pi Hub desktop app
nodes.summary: Tauri window with a tab per hub (child webviews); live taskbar icon (1-2 hub icons with dots, 3-4 a state-dot matrix) and tray icon from each hub page's title line; overlay badge with count only on pinned buttons; own AppUserModelID; external links open in the default browser; hide to tray, single instance, remembers maximized, staged-update swap at start.
nodes.tech: hub/app (Rust + Tauri 2, ui/index.html strip, ui/icons.js built from hub/web/icons.ts)
nodes.details: Installed, staged and removed by the hub (hub/src/app-install.ts) from SHA-256 pins in hub/app/release.json; releases built by .github/workflows/app-release.yml on tag app-v*; pins written by hub/app/pin-release.mjs.

nodes.label: wormhole.app
nodes.summary: Undocumented site API plus Backblaze B2 pieces; receives end-to-end encrypted files (24 h, unlimited downloads).
nodes.details: Chat file-link menu Upload / Zip and upload / 7z and upload; only files Download would serve; key stays in the link's #fragment.
